grand_null_target: After Paper-2-specific names and presentation vocabulary are suppressed, each selected substantive Paper-2 claim's required distinctions can be represented by already-frozen architecture plus existing claim/evidence machinery, without a newly necessary top-level system role, layer, or reflexivity-only semantic primitive.
scope_and_limits: F0 tests only coarse label-independent structural distinguishability. Colliding F0 signatures demonstrate that L_sys/L_claim/L_ctx/L_formal layer locations and source ClaimIR generic relation-kind topology alone do not uniquely reconstruct scientific claim meaning.
F0 collisions alone do NOT reject the full Grand Null, which permits the existing L_claim assertion machinery, semantic predicates/qualifiers and frozen evidence.
F0 unique signature does NOT prove exact semantic reconstruction or soundness.

F1 must independently test exact v2 predicate-family/qualifier/reference bindings for each relation, including negation, modal limits, time/evidence scopes and original source ClaimIR unbound node watches. Do not treat 63 descriptive tags as automatically admitted assertion primitives.
A model that has already seen original target labels/wordings does not count as an independently blinded human reconstruction.
The original PVS-CNC-02.r2 causal_position carrier issue is retained and is distinct from the seven self-target unbound node watches.

include: frozen typed architecture schema/role references on those arguments

f0_signature_rule: At relation level, canonicalize kind + ordered argument layer symbols + sorted typed existing architecture object references per argument. Ignore any source-specific node identity/description and audit operator/context tags. Separately report how many relation pairs share the same label-suppressed signature and how many signatures are singletons. This is a LOWER BOUND on ambiguity under this intentionally reduced representation, not a test of the full carrier.
f0_invariance_control: Rename every source ClaimIR node ID to independent anonymous tokens without touching arg index/layer/type topology; recomputed F0 signature histogram must be identical. This syntactic permutation must not depend on Paper-2-specific terms.
f1_syntactic_watches: The existing v2 semantic_references field can reference existing ClaimIR nodes absent from source_arguments. Test seven identified self-target unbound nodes for syntactic admissibility only, not automatically semantic FULL.
f1_and_f2_rule: Do not declare Grand Null success or failure until exact v2 carrier coverage, an explicit contradiction/ambiguity test, source-referent fidelity and independently label-suppressed reconstruction are separately completed and frozen.
stage_f_exit: F0 pilot is admissible only as a baseline. Keep final Grand Null verdict pending.
